name: Wanderlust: The Magnificent Journey
source:
Experience the story of Kaelyn Kirena, who more than anything has always dreamed of traveling the world with her best friends at her side.
Unfortunately, fate hasn’t been kind to Kay, and she was stricken partially blind by a strange, uncurable, and debilitating illness.
Day after day, her eyesight continues to worsen and she’s starting to lose hope that she’ll ever get to see the beautiful sights depicted in the postcards that she’s collected since she was a small child.

That was, until one day…

One day, her friends decided on a whim to take a chance.
They all gathered up what money and resources they could for the sole mission of using it all to help their dear friend fulfill their lifelong wish — to see the world, and all of the magnificent sights that it provides.

The grand journey across this wonderful planet of ours is set to begin.
The question is, will you be joining these friends on their big adventure?
It’s time to go out and see the world!

[From [url=https://shamrock-creations.com/wanderlust/]official website[/url]]
